core_obligations: Classify possible quotient invariants and derive the allowed total-space s-invariants.
Retain the explicit realization tables and quotient constructions.
Produce infinitely many inequivalent actions and transfer positive Ricci metrics from the author-selected quotients.
difficulty_reason: The author classifies principal-circle total spaces through Kreck-Stolz invariants, constructs spin and non-spin quotient manifolds and realizes the admissible invariant triples. The infinite-family conclusion uses congruence-preserving integer families together with nondiffeomorphic orbit spaces; the Ricci statement adds geometry of core metrics and invariant metrics on principal bundles. The original computational realization tables are retained as part of the author proof, without independently certifying or rerunning their mathematics.

dedup.scope: Common existing-claims and public-items searched by SIGMA.2026.094 and arXiv2603.29838; no same source record. compared.difference: Base cohomology-S2xS5 classification versus the extension to connected sums with nonzero second/third Betti numbers and arbitrary homotopy spheres.
